items.title: The Pentagon will livestream Nidal Hasan's execution
items.summary: Pete Hegseth announced that the firing-squad execution of Nidal Hasan, who killed 13 people at Fort Hood in 2009, will be public, at Fort Hood on Dec 3, "so people can watch it," and the Pentagon then said it would livestream it. "Nidal Hasan" and "execution" both trended. Posts like "Public executions aren't something a developed country partakes in" (19K) ran against cheers for Hegseth, and Nick Sortor said he would stream it on X (36K). Catholic bishops condemned the plan the next day, and on Oct 10 Pope Leo posted that the death penalty is "inadmissible" (122K).
